job_role_description: Manages financial operations, assets, liabilities, equity and cash flow to maintain the financial health and operative viability of the company.
Plans, directs and coordinates personnel policies, recruitment, training, compensation, labour relations and employee welfare for the organisation.
Plans, directs and coordinates the acquisition, development, maintenance and use of information and communications technology systems and services.
Plans, directs and coordinates the sales and marketing activities of the enterprise, developing strategies to reach commercial and revenue targets.
Plans, directs and coordinates the provision of business support and administration services not elsewhere classified within the organisation.
Oversees the management of one or several bank activities, setting policies that promote safe banking operations and ensuring commercial and social targets are met.
Trades foreign exchange and money-market instruments on behalf of the institution, managing positions and risk across currency and interest-rate markets.
Buys and sells financial securities and instruments for clients, advising on transactions and executing trades in financial markets.
Performs quantitative analyses of financial information, evaluates investments and prepares reports to support business and investment decisions.
Plans and maintains financial accounting systems, prepares and certifies financial statements and ensures compliance with accounting standards.
Aligns human-resources strategy with business needs, advising line management on workforce planning, talent and organisational development.
Provides specialist services in recruitment, staffing, training, career development and personnel administration for the organisation.
Researches, designs, develops and tests software systems and applications, applying engineering principles to build maintainable software.
Leads the design and development of complex software systems, sets technical direction and mentors developers within the engineering team.
Writes, tests and maintains programme code for software applications based on technical specifications and design documents.
Monitors and supports the day-to-day operation of ICT systems, performs routine maintenance and resolves operational incidents.
Represents the company to sell goods and services to businesses and organisations, maintaining client relationships and meeting sales targets.
Processes routine over-the-counter banking transactions for customers, including deposits, withdrawals, payments and account enquiries.
Supervises and coordinates the activities of clerical and administrative staff, organising workflows and ensuring service quality.
Studies the market of banking products, adapts existing products or creates new ones to suit client needs and monitors product performance indicators.
Identifies, assesses and mitigates financial, operational and compliance risks, defining controls and monitoring the organisation's risk exposure.
Ensures the organisation operates within legal and regulatory requirements, monitoring policies and advising on compliance obligations.
Examines and evaluates the organisation's internal controls, governance and accounting processes to ensure accuracy and compliance.
Collects, processes and analyses data sets to identify trends and produce insights that support business decision-making.
Plans, executes and closes projects, managing scope, schedule, budget and stakeholders to deliver defined business outcomes.
Directs a major division of the enterprise, setting strategy and objectives and accountable for the division's overall performance.
Provides overall strategic leadership and direction for the enterprise, accountable to the board for the organisation's performance.
Plans and directs quality assurance, health, safety and environment programmes, ensuring compliance with standards and regulations.
Handles customer enquiries, requests and complaints across channels, providing information and resolving issues to ensure satisfaction.
Assesses the creditworthiness of borrowers, analysing financial data and preparing recommendations on lending decisions and credit limits.
